findings.detail: The extracted percentage-of-net-assets aggregate is 14.99%, but the filing's own total investment portfolio row reports 179.79% for the same $2,292,614,325 fair value total.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The filing anchors total investments at fair value to $2,292,614,325 and the SOI total investment portfolio row reports 179.79% of net assets. The flagged extracted pct_sum is 14.99%, so the source does not support the observed aggregate percentage; this is an extraction gap in the percentage-of-net-assets aggregate rather than a false alarm.
